hooks.prompt:
A message is about to reach the maintainer. Hook input: $ARGUMENTS

Read the constitution in .specify/memory/constitution.md at the repository root (the hook input's cwd, or the nearest directory above it that holds that file). Judge the message in tool_input against the constitution as that file states it, every principle and the Source Register. Read the session transcript at transcript_path to see which sources the session actually read and what the maintainer asked; the transcript may lag behind the latest turn.

If the message complies, return {"ok": true}. If it does not, return {"ok": false, "reason": "..."} naming each principle it breaks, quoting the part of the message that breaks it, and saying what the constitution requires instead.

Claude has finished a response. Hook input: $ARGUMENTS

Read the constitution in .specify/memory/constitution.md at the repository root (the hook input's cwd, or the nearest directory above it that holds that file). Judge last_assistant_message against the constitution as that file states it, every principle and the Source Register. Read the session transcript at transcript_path to see which sources the session actually read and what was asked; the transcript may lag behind the latest turn. A response with no answer, conclusion or question in it complies.

If it complies, return {"ok": true}. If it does not, return {"ok": false, "reason": "..."} naming each principle it breaks, quoting the part that breaks it, and saying what the constitution requires instead.
